question: Which of these is a constitutional institution in the UK?
romanUrdu: In mein se kaunsi UK ki constitutional institution hai?
explanation: Parliament is a constitutional institution; private bodies such as companies and clubs are not.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What food shortage caused the Great Famine in Ireland in the mid-19th century?
romanUrdu: 19th sadi ke ausat mein Ireland ke Great Famine ki wajah kaunsi khurai ki kami thi?
explanation: The potato crop failed, causing the Great Famine in Ireland.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.3 A global power: Ireland and the Great Famine

question: What is the group of senior opposition MPs who challenge government policy called?
romanUrdu: Government policy ko challenge karne wale senior opposition MPs ke group ko kya kaha jata hai?
explanation: Senior opposition MPs form the Shadow Cabinet.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Which TWO are responsibilities of MPs? Select two.
romanUrdu: MPs ki DO zimmedariyan kaunsi hain?
explanation: MPs represent their constituents and help create laws.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Who was the longest-serving UK Prime Minister of the 20th century by continuous tenure?
romanUrdu: 20th sadi mein musalsal sab se lambi muddat tak UK Prime Minister kaun rahe?
explanation: Margaret Thatcher served continuously from 1979 to 1990, the longest continuous tenure of a 20th-century UK Prime Minister.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What name is given to territories linked to the Crown but not part of the UK?
romanUrdu: Crown se linked lekin UK ka hissa na hone wale territories ko kya kaha jata hai?
explanation: Crown Dependencies, such as the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands, are linked to the Crown but are not part of the UK.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 2.2 What is the UK? Crown Dependencies

question: To which area of study did David Hume contribute during the Scottish Enlightenment?
romanUrdu: Scottish Enlightenment mein David Hume ne kis shobe mein hissa dala?
explanation: David Hume was a philosopher of the Scottish Enlightenment.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What proportion of England's population died in the Black Death?
romanUrdu: Black Death mein England ki kitni abadi mari?
explanation: The Black Death killed about one third of the population of England.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.5 The Middle Ages: the Black Death

question: What happened to King Charles I after he was imprisoned in the Civil War?
romanUrdu: Civil War mein qaid hone ke baad King Charles I ke saath kya hua?

choices.text: He became a Member of Parliament

explanation: Charles I was executed in 1649.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.6 The Tudors and Stuarts: Charles I

question: Which TWO are constitutional responsibilities of the Monarch? Select two.
romanUrdu: Monarch ki DO constitutional zimmedariyan kaunsi hain?

choices.text: Advise, warn and encourage the Prime Minister

explanation: The monarch appoints the government and has the right to advise, warn and encourage the Prime Minister.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What kind of disaster was the Black Death?
romanUrdu: Black Death kis qisam ki aafat thi?
explanation: The Black Death was a plague epidemic that reached Britain in 1348.

question: Which country was Britain in frequent conflict with over trade and colonies in the 18th century?
romanUrdu: 18th sadi mein trade aur colonies par Britain ka kis mulk se bar bar takrao tha?
explanation: Britain fought France frequently in the 18th century over trade and colonies.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.3 A global power: war with France

question: Is the Speaker of the House of Commons an MP who represents a constituency?
romanUrdu: Kya House of Commons ka Speaker ek MP hai jo constituency ki numaindagi karta hai?

choices.text: No, the Speaker is not an MP
No, the Speaker sits in the Lords

explanation: The Speaker is an MP who represents a constituency and deals with constituents' issues.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Where is Skara Brae, a well-preserved prehistoric village?
romanUrdu: Skara Brae, ek behtar mehfooz prehistoric gaon, kahan hai?
explanation: Skara Brae is a prehistoric village in Orkney, Scotland.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Which of these plays was written by William Shakespeare?
romanUrdu: In mein se kaunsa play William Shakespeare ne likha?
explanation: Macbeth is a play by William Shakespeare.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Where was William the Conqueror from?
romanUrdu: William the Conqueror kahan se thay?
explanation: William the Conqueror was Duke of Normandy before invading England in 1066.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What were the Dutch-origin settlers who fought the British in South Africa called?
romanUrdu: South Africa mein British se larne wale Dutch asal ke settlers ko kya kaha jata tha?
explanation: The Boers were Dutch-origin settlers in South Africa.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: In Northern Ireland, are Youth Court cases heard by up to three specially trained magistrates or a District Judge?
romanUrdu: Northern Ireland mein kya Youth Court cases teen specially trained magistrates ya District Judge sunte hain?

choices.text: No, a jury of twelve hears them
No, they are heard in Parliament

explanation: In Northern Ireland, Youth Court cases are heard by up to three specially trained magistrates or a District Judge.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What achievement made Sir Roger Bannister famous?
romanUrdu: Sir Roger Bannister kis kamyabi se mashhoor hue?

choices.text: He ran the first officially recorded mile in under four minutes
He won an Olympic gold medal in swimming

explanation: Roger Bannister ran the first officially recorded sub-four-minute mile in 1954.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Who was invited to take the English throne in 1688 during the Glorious Revolution?
romanUrdu: 1688 ki Glorious Revolution mein English takht par kis ko bulaya gaya?
explanation: William of Orange was invited to take the throne in 1688.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: Who was defeated at the Battle of the Boyne in 1690?
romanUrdu: 1690 ki Battle of the Boyne mein kise shikast hui?
explanation: James II was defeated by William III at the Battle of the Boyne in 1690.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition
sources.locator: 3.6 The Tudors and Stuarts: the Battle of the Boyne

question: What did the Factories Act of 1847 introduce?
romanUrdu: Factories Act 1847 ne kya muta'arif karwaya?

choices.text: The right to vote for women
A ten-hour limit on working hours for women and children in textile mills

explanation: The Factories Act 1847, the Ten Hours Act, limited working hours for women and children in textile mills.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: What is the group of official-opposition MPs who scrutinise government departments called?
romanUrdu: Government departments ki nigrani karne wale official opposition MPs ke group ko kya kaha jata hai?
explanation: The Shadow Cabinet is made up of senior opposition MPs who scrutinise the government.

sources.title: Life in the UK: A guide for new residents, 3rd edition

question: In which devolved area can the Scottish Parliament legislate?
romanUrdu: Scottish Parliament kis devolved area mein qanoon bana sakti hai?
explanation: Education is devolved to the Scottish Parliament; defence, foreign affairs and immigration are reserved.
